key_insight: A conditional quantum prior learns how selected chaotic-system statistics vary with a parameter, generalizing to unseen values within the training range without retraining.
engineering_relevance: Regularizing classical predictors with this prior can improve long-term statistical fidelity and forecast accuracy while sharing trainable weights across parameter values.
method: Train a parameter-conditioned quantum generative model on selected invariant-measure statistics.
Use the learned prior to regularize classical neural-network autoregressive rollouts.
Implement a photonic quantum prior for NISQ devices.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 56.9% lower mean Jensen–Shannon divergence than a comparably sized MLP across 96 unseen Lorenz-63 parameter values, 84.7% fewer weights than separate quantum models across 101 values, and 66.0% lower forecast MSE over 318 Kolmogorov-flow steps at Re=1000.
watch_item: Results establish interpolation within the training parameter range, not extrapolation or computational speedup over classical methods.
paper_title: Conditional Quantum Priors for Chaotic Fluid Dynamics
